description: Phase 7 higher-shot validation of gr_beta_bump_n4 using the best audited opt-3 seed-45678 candidate. This is a direct-distribution quantity-of-interest validation campaign, not an amplified-QAE campaign.
rationale: The Phase 3/6/7 paper-quality summary leaves gr_beta_bump_n4 mean_x and upper_half as pending replication.
The Phase 5 opt-3 seed-45678 repeat did not improve global TVD, but it preserved useful quantity-of-interest evidence for mean_x and upper_half.
A higher-shot repeat tests whether those two functionals remain stable enough to move from pending_replication to paper-quality or bias-caveated evidence.
The campaign measures the Grover-Rudolph distribution only. It does not run Grover amplification or QAE.

selected_cases.label: beta-like localized bump, 16 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Higher-shot Phase 7 replication of the localized n=4 profile for mean_x and upper_half functionals.

stopping_rules: Do not attach Grover amplification to gr_beta_bump_n4 in this campaign.
If mean_x or upper_half remains below 0.01 absolute error with interval coverage, promote it to paper-quality evidence.
If either remains below 0.01 without interval coverage, keep it as paper-quality with explicit bias caveat.
If global TVD remains above 0.04, do not claim a global distribution-preparation success for this localized profile.
